rules.text: Every approach shows a valid signal (red, yellow or green) and a non-negative, finite queue.
The N/S and E/W directions are never both non-red (green or yellow) in the same second.
Before a direction turns green, the opposite direction has been red for at least all_red_seconds.
A green always ends in yellow, and every yellow lasts at least yellow_seconds before red.
No approach waits at red with vehicles queued for more than 200 seconds.

args.explanation: With actuated=true the EW green gaps out when its own queue empties (E queue 0 at steps 105-106) while NS has demand. The controller then starts EW yellow at step 106 but truncates it to 2s, going all-red/ red by step 108, instead of holding the required yellow_seconds=4. Fixed-time (actuated=false) with identical timing keeps the full yellow and passes, and extending the run still reports the same 2s yellow at step 108, so it is not end-of-run truncation.
